## Scope

## Non-Goals

## Tasks

- [ ] Add a durable transcript (doc or issue comment) that temporarily removes the `no-renderable-content` guard in `src/deliverable_render/store/validate.py`, shows the named test failing, restores the guard, and shows it passing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The transcript shows `tests/store/test_communication_render_profile.py` failing after removal of the `no-renderable-content` guard.
- [ ] The transcript shows the test passing after the guard is restored.

## Implementation Notes

Evidence paths: `src/deliverable_render/store/validate.py`; `tests/store/test_communication_render_profile.py`.

Original issue: #47. Merged PR: #60 (`dbf75a7d5b1b`).
